question: Why must revilers of Shiva and slanderers of Kula Bhairava be denied the teaching?
premises: The teaching must not be given to a reviler of Shiva
It must not be given to a slanderer
inference: Those who revile Shiva or slander Kula Bhairava are excluded from receiving it.
uncertainties: kulabhairave may qualify nindake or stand as a separate locative context
plain_english: Not to a reviler of Shiva, O goddess, nor to a slanderer of Kula Bhairava.
